name: sdlc-cache
description: Shows how well this conversation's prompt cache works: hit rate of the last request, session totals, and a countdown to the moment the cache lapses.

ttl.title: Cache lifetime
ttl.description: Force 5m or 1h; auto is one hour unless Claude Code is set to five minutes or the request timing shows otherwise

warnSeconds.title: Warn before expiry (seconds)
warnSeconds.description: Turn the countdown yellow, and toast once, this many seconds before the cache lapses

showStatus.title: Status line entry
showStatus.description: Also put a short cache summary in the status line
